components.name: Action title field
components.description: Visible label and native text input used by the inline add form.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-title">Что хочется сделать?</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-title" placeholder="Например, выключить утюг" maxlength="120" required />
components.css: .ds-field-label {display:block;margin-bottom:9px;color:var(--ink, #20231f);font:15px/1.5 Cantarell,sans-serif;} .ds-field {width:100%;min-height:50px;border:1px solid #83887b;border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;color:var(--ink, #20231f);background:#fafbf7;font:17px/1.5 Cantarell,sans-serif;} .ds-field::placeholder {color:var(--muted, #62665d);opacity:1;} .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #bc321c); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Day navigation
components.description: The selected day uses a solid green surface; recorded days carry a dot.
components.css: .ds-week {display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;padding:14px 0;border-block:1px solid var(--line, #c9ccc3);max-width:280px;} .ds-day {position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px;min-height:70px;padding:7px 2px 12px;border:0;border-radius:12px;color:var(--ink, #20231f);background:transparent;font-family:Cantarell,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;cursor:pointer;} .ds-weekday {font-size:12px;color:var(--muted, #62665d);} .ds-number {font-size:20px;line-height:1.2;} .ds-day:hover {background:#e5e7df;} .ds-day[aria-current="date"] {background:var(--green, #304f40);color:var(--surface, #f2f3ee);} .ds-day[aria-current="date"] .ds-weekday {color:#e0e8de;} .ds-today .ds-number {text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px;} .ds-recorded::after {content:"";position:absolute;bottom:5px;width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;} .ds-day:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #bc321c); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Daily checkbox
components.description: A native checkbox with visible checked text and a green saved state.
components.css: .ds-check {display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:48px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink, #20231f);font:16px/1.5 Cantarell,sans-serif;} .ds-check input {appearance:none;display:grid;place-items:center;width:26px;height:26px;border:1.5px solid #83887b;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;margin:0;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;} .ds-check input:checked {border-color:var(--green, #304f40);background:var(--green, #304f40);} .ds-check input:checked::after {content:"";width:10px;height:6px;border:solid var(--surface, #f2f3ee);border-width:0 0 2px 2px;transform:translateY(-1px) rotate(-45deg);} .ds-check input:checked+span {color:var(--green, #304f40);} .ds-check input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #bc321c); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Timestamp history
components.description: Native disclosure exposes repeated recorded facts as compact time chips.
components.css: .ds-history {color:var(--muted, #62665d);font:13px/1.5 Cantarell,sans-serif;} .ds-history summary {cursor:pointer;padding-block:5px;width:fit-content;} .ds-history summary:hover {color:var(--green, #304f40);} .ds-history summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #bc321c); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-times {display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:9px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none;} .ds-times time {display:block;padding:4px 9px;background:var(--green-soft, #e4ebe2);border-radius:5px;color:var(--green, #304f40);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}

components.name: Text action
components.description: Quiet inline settings, cancel and history actions.

narrative.overview:
A calm, readable place to record an action and return to its time. The limestone surface, ink and locally hosted Cantarell inherit the studio’s visual foundation. Deep green gives actions and saved facts their own quiet identity. This document governs only the `todo/` route; the studio and story retain their own design authority.

Dates, status and existing facts lead the hierarchy. A single unboxed list keeps the experience practical and personal, with no decorative imagery or competing dashboard summaries.
keyCharacteristics: Recorded times remain prominent and easy to scan.
Flat, unboxed rows use fine rules and generous spacing.
Green identifies actions, selected dates and saved states.
Forms expand inline; destructive confirmation uses a native dialog.

rules.name: The Saved Fact Rule
rules.body: Use green state and a visible timestamp together to communicate a recorded action; color alone is insufficient.

rules.name: The Time First Rule
rules.body: Keep the recorded time larger than supporting status and schedule text. Do not replace exact times with achievement language.

dos: Do retain the local Cantarell family, limestone surface and ink foundation.
Do put real dates, recorded status and exact times before secondary controls.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, native control semantics and announced feedback.
Do stack status and full-width recording controls on small screens.
Do keep additions and settings inline and use a native dialog for deletion.
donts: Don't add card shells or ambient shadows to action rows.
Don't invent recorded actions, completion scores, streaks or pressure to perform.
Don't hide the recorded time when showing a completed state.
Don't show historical days as editable or future dates as available.
Don't imply remote synchronization or successful saving after storage failure.
